name: venguard-rules-test
description: Security-rules tests: Realtime Database (devices, Spark plan) and Firestore (team dashboard). Run against the Firebase emulators.

scripts.test: firebase emulators:exec --project demo-venguard --only database,firestore --config firebase.json "node --test rules.test.mjs firestore.test.mjs"
scripts.test:firestore: firebase emulators:exec --project demo-venguard --only firestore --config firebase.json "node --test firestore.test.mjs"
